intro.text: A resident of Beacon who helped test Nomad's engine designs.
A resident of Beacon and one of the five engineers on Solemnity Divine's team.

items.text: Helped test the prototypes of Nomad's steam-powered engine and refine the design.

personality.text: Nomad regarded the engineering team as skilled, knowledgeable overachievers, though Canticle's harsh conditions had kept them from studying some ideas that would be basic on other worlds.
